If EthSMWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE and EthSM is in state ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_ONLINE and ComM requests now COMM_FULL_ COMMUNICATIO N_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST , then EthSM shall request the corresponding EthIfCtrl with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST.

If EthSMWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE and EthSM is in state ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_ONLINE and ComM requests now COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATIO N_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST , then EthSM shall request the corresponding EthIfCtrl with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST.
